effect.en: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent.  Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.

flavor.ko: 상대를 쓰러뜨리면 트레이너와의 유대감이 깊어져서 지우개굴닌자로 변한다. 물수리검이 강해진다.
flavor.en: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its bond with its Trainer is strengthened, and its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted.
